title: Constancy theorem for a stationary varifold on ℝ^N supported in an n-plane
statement: Assume ConstancyTheorem (Simon 8.4.1, corrected: M ∩ U connected). Let C be a stationary n-varifold on U = ℝ^N and T ∈ G(N,n) with spt μ_C ⊆ T (as a subset of ℝ^N). Then there is θ ≥ 0 with C = θ v(T), i.e. C.measure = ofReal θ • planeVarifoldMeasure T, where v(T)(A) = H^n({y ∈ T : (y,T) ∈ A}).
lean_statement: ConstancyTheorem → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (T : Grassmannian N n), C.Stationary → C.weight.support ⊆ (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) → ∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ C.measure = ENNReal.ofReal θ • planeVarifoldMeasure T
